sanskrit_verse: विगतक्रोधसंतापो हृष्टरूपो यदा नृपः। प्रजानां दर्शनं याति सोम इत्युच्यते तदा॥
transliteration: vigatakrodhasaṃtāpo hṛṣṭarūpo yadā nṛpaḥ | prajānāṃ darśanaṃ yāti soma ityucyate tadā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the king, free from anger and distress, approaches his subjects with joy and visibility, he becomes Soma — the nourisher and unifier of collective consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from conscious accessibility and emotional transparency.
Causation arises through visible alignment between ruler and ruled.
Capacity-based responsibility includes affective presence and energetic harmony.
Restoration logic operates through the sovereign's inner purification manifesting as public welfare.
Consciousness alignment occurs when leadership reflects non-reactive joy and clarity.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler exhibits chronic anger OR concealed affect THEN legitimacy score = null.
IF ruler demonstrates visible accessibility AND emotional transparency THEN governance efficacy = maximum.
WHEN sovereign aligns internal state with public duty THEN societal harmony coefficient increases.
IF leader engages subjects without reactive distortion THEN constitutional trust index rises.
WHEN ruler embodies somatic peace THEN jurisdictional dharma stabilizes automatically.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that a judge or chief executive whose decision-making process lacks visible emotional clarity and accessible intent breaches the foundational capacity for lawful sovereignty. Such deficiency nullifies juridical authenticity at origin.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramāṇa-based observation, the sequential unfolding (anupūrvaśaḥ) of kingly conduct reveals that absence of anger and presence of delight directly cause social integration. This causality is non-coercive and inherently restorative; thus, punitive interpretation is invalid where alignment prevails naturally.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign introspection protocol until emotional neutrality is restored.
Deploy public visibility module to reestablish transparent interaction channels.
Activate joy-induction sequence within administrative body to recalibrate energetic field.
Enforce completion process wherein ruler assumes full causal ownership of prior misalignments.
Reintegrate integrity framework via ceremonial reaffirmation of dharmic service vow.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: rulers derive legitimate power only through purified consciousness made visible in joyful service. Dharma is thereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
